item.title: Iran proposes a 7-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's president says Tehran wants a deal with the U.S. before November's midterm elections, as the regime puts an offer on the table.

item.title: Hurricane Nolo could cause "catastrophic" flooding in Hawaii, forecasters warn
item.description: Nolo could become a major hurricane by the weekend as it nears Hawaii's Big Island, forecasters say.

item.title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 5 storm off Mexico. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo regained Category 5 status as its intensity fluctuated between Category 4 and Category 5 — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast.

item.title: Oil prices back up as U.S. and Iran trade threats to expand 7-month war
item.description: As Iran responds to Trump's threat of annihilation with its own warning of a possible "new front" in the war, global oil prices are rising again.

item.title: Duckworth slams Trump's "foolhardy plan" to make triumphal arch a military complex
item.description: Democratic Sen. Tammy Duckworth of Illinois is demanding the Pentagon and Federal Aviation Administration reject President Trump's call to convert plans for a massive triumphal arch into a "top grade Military Complex."

item.title: Ex-N.C. State trainer accused of sexual abuse is arrested in Florida
item.description: Robert M. Murphy Jr. is accused of sexually abusing former Wolfpack male athletes under the guise of treatment.

item.title: Trump welcomes China's Xi for state dinner at White House
item.description: President Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping for a state dinner on Thursday, as the world's two most powerful countries extend a tariff truce and grapple with a rivalry on advanced AI.

item.title: ICE wasted millions in rapid push to expand detention capacity, watchdog finds
item.description: With an unprecedented budget, ICE spent billions in a rush to expand its detention network, wasting millions in the process, the Government Accountability Office found.

item.title: U.S. military lays groundwork for potential action around Cuba
item.description: Some units would "possibly [be] needed in 90-120 days," according to an internal Army message reviewed by CBS News.

item.title: Pittsburgh doctor attacked and killed while he slept, wife also stabbed
item.description: Dr. Idris Evans, a physician and medical director from UPMC Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, was killed in an overnight stabbing.

item.title: Man wounded during 2024 Trump rally shooting in Butler County dies
item.description: One of the men who was wounded in the 2024 attempted assassination of President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania, has died.

item.title: Abraham Accords countries hold first official meeting since Oct. 7 attacks
item.description: Ten blocks away from the United Nations General Assembly​, U.S. diplomats quietly kickstarted the expansion of the Abraham Accords from the 43rd floor of a midtown Manhattan office tower.

item.title: Trump to headline "Golden Age" event with top officials, tech executives
item.description: President Trump is slated to speak on Tuesday in Washington at an event that features Elon Musk, Jensen Huang and others, according to invitation materials reviewed by CBS News.

item.title: California sheriff unlawfully seized ballots, state Supreme Court rules
item.description: The California Supreme Court ruled that Riverside County Sheriff Chad Bianco violated that state's election law by ordering his deputies to seize more than 650,000 ballots.

item.title: This week on "Sunday Morning" (Sept. 27)
item.description: A look at the features for this week's broadcast of the Emmy-winning program, hosted by Jane Pauley.

item.title: Commander rejected plans to rebase before deadly drone strike, sources say
item.description: Sources tell CBS News that despite warnings about the vulnerability of the outpost in Kuwait, a commander opted not to rebase farther from Iran.

item.title: Bob Pettit, NBA Hall of Famer and its first MVP, dies at 93
item.description: Bob Pettit was an All-American at LSU before going on to the NBA, where he was an All-Star for each of his 11 seasons, all with the Hawks. He led them to the 1958 championship over the mighty Boston Celtics, the Hawks' lone title.

item.title: Falcons and Packers kick off Week 3 of NFL season
item.description: Week 3 of the NFL season kicks off on Thursday with the Atlanta Falcons heading to Wisconsin to face the Green Bay Packers. CBS Sports NFL analyst Mike Renner has more.

item.title: Wild high-speed chase causes chaos in Florida
item.description: Police said a man broke himself out of a hospital, carjacked a woman and led authorities on a wild chase in Miami-Dade County on Thursday. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: GOP Sen. Thom Tillis on Trump-Xi visit: "It's a WTF moment"
item.description: The retiring North Carolina senator was critical of President Trump's reception of Chinese President Xi Jinping.

item.title: DOJ says it's moving to end more than 50 decades-old school desegregation cases
item.description: The Justice Department said Thursday it was seeking to end more than 50 long-standing consent decrees dating back decades that sought to curb unlawful racial segregation that was prevalent during the Jim Crow era.

item.title: New Trump-focused "Love Me" ad campaign paid for by taxpayers hits airwaves
item.description: Ads promoting President Trump and paid for by American taxpayers are now airing on network and national cable.

item.title: New polling from Maine, Michigan and New Hampshire shows mixed results for Democrats
item.description: New polls from Maine, Michigan, and New Hampshire show Democratic candidates in mixed positions ahead of midterms. CBS News political reporter Zak Hudak breaks it down.

item.title: Trump criticized for hailing deep friendship with China's Xi Jinping amid AI war
item.description: President Trump is facing criticism for his warm treatment of China's Xi Jinping as the two leaders meet at the White House to discuss Iran, AI, and more. CBS News' Katherine Watson has more.

item.title: 9/24: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump hosts Xi Jinping at White House; Sen. Thom Tillis on elaborate Trump-Xi visit.

item.title: Pentagon probing how shipment of F-35 fighter jet parts was diverted
item.description: The U.S. is trying to retrieve the parts, which were reported by Bloomberg News to be in China's possession.

item.title: New bill would lower Social Security retirement age for some workers
item.description: Workers in physically demanding jobs should be able to collect full Social Security retirement benefits at age 60, a Michigan lawmaker says.

item.title: Trump administration urges Supreme Court to revive third-country deportation policy
item.description: The Trump administration urged the Supreme Court to revive its policy of deporting some migrants to places other than their country of birth.

item.title: One Ukrainian school is teaching kids to fly, build, and repair drones
item.description: A Ukrainian school is teaching kids to fly, build, and repair drones. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: She was a California comeback story, serving juvenile probation in a UC Davis dorm for killing a teen, when arrested again
item.description: A Sacramento County judge ordered her into a UC Davis program for formerly incarcerated students. She was arrested seven months later, accused of dealing drugs from her dorm, where officers found ammunition.
